purpose: Tell a governor on the march what you would have him look for

tone.text: I write to you {choice}, while you are still on the road.

options.text: having thought further on the matter
with every confidence in your judgement
because I should have said this before you left
and I hope this finds you in time

options.label: the best ground he can find
options.text: Settle where the land is best. I will not pretend to know it better than you do from here.

options.label: toward the coast
options.text: Keep toward the water. I would rather a poorer harvest that a ship can reach than a fat one that nothing can.

options.label: near the ore
options.text: Look to the rock. Grain we can buy; iron we cannot, and I am tired of paying for it.

options.label: away from the tribes
options.text: Go wide of the people who are already there. I am aware what it will cost you in ground, and I would rather pay it than the other thing.

closing.text: Written in haste, and sent after you,
